rule: tfopwg_disp in CP/KP (positive), FP, FA; 0.5 ≤ P ≤ 13.0 d; period, mid-time and duration published; one TOI per star; seeded order; halves by sha256(seed:TIC) parity
note: Tuning half: every field, dispositions included. Held-out half: only what a blind search needs (TIC, TOI name, ephemeris); no disposition, class, depth or radius.
